# MCP Server Instructions

The following MCP servers have provided instructions for how to use their tools and resources:

## claude.ai Claude Docs
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{…}},"markdown":"# <title>\n\n<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>\n\n<?claude block s1?>\n\n<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: "<root id>"`.

- mdview: View a markdown or docs file in the local mdview browser viewer and return a shareable URL. Use when the user asks to preview/open/render a markdown file, or after writing docs that read better in a browser (long docs, tables, Mermaid diagrams, multi-file doc sets).
- ak-advise: Interview until user and agent share the outcome picture, preview it, then give evidence-backed advice. - Invoke for second opinions or plan pressure-tests before planning; implementation goes to a delivery workflow.
- ak-agent-browser: Automate tool-managed browsers with agent-browser for snapshots, clicks, forms and browser testing. - Invoke for browser automation; real Chrome account state needs chrome-profile.
- ak-agentize: Expose existing code or APIs as an agent-friendly CLI, MCP server, or both. - Invoke to ship code as a tool for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or skills.sh.
- ak-agentkit: Route AgentKit work by classifying the task, chaining installed skills and spawning subagents at trigger points; also operate the ak CLI. - Invoke at the start of multi-step work, when the right skill is unclear, or when the next action is an ak subcommand.
- ak-ai-artist: Generate mockups, brand visuals and concept art via Nano Banana in search, creative or wild mode, with styles like Ukiyo-e and Bento grid. - Invoke for visual assets or prompt search.
- ak-ai-multimodal: Analyze and generate image, audio, video and document content, falling back from native vision to the Multix CLI and live provider catalogs. - Invoke for media generation, transcription or OCR the model cannot do.
- ak-ask: Answer technical and architecture questions on design decisions, best practices or solution comparisons. - Invoke for analysis-only answers before changing code.
- ak-atoz: Take a request A to Z: lock scope via ak-advise, collect all prerequisites first, then run parallel sub-sessions on a GitHub issue until each Done-means item is verified. - Invoke for one upfront confirmation, no check-ins; advice or preflight only goes to ak-advise or ak-goal-warmup.
- ak-autoresearch: Route bounded, goal-directed iteration to the AgentKit skill that owns the desired outcome. - Invoke when repeated, verified iterations should improve a measurable result.
- ak-backend-development: Implement server code in Node.js, Python or Go (Express, NestJS, FastAPI, Django): endpoints, services, data access, auth, tests. - Invoke for handlers, slow endpoints or N+1 queries; schema-only design is ak-databases.
- ak-better-auth: Add Better Auth (TypeScript): email/password, OAuth (Google, GitHub), 2FA/MFA, passkeys/WebAuthn, sessions, RBAC, rate limiting. - Invoke when setting up or extending an app's authentication.
- ak-bootstrap: Bootstrap web, mobile, CLI, API, MCP, WebMCP or library projects via ak-cook, ak-code-review, ak-enhance-ux-ax --auto and optional verified release; no planning. - Invoke to start from scratch in auto, full, fast or parallel mode; --ask locks scope via ak-advise.
- ak-brainstorm: Turn unclear intent into an accepted outcome and compare viable approaches before delivery. - Use when opening multi-step delivery or picking between viable fixes.
- ak-bro: Restate the assistant's last message in simpler, shorter, jargon-free language. - Use when the user says ak-bro, simplify that, or say it plainly.
- ak-chrome-profile: Drive a real Google Chrome profile via Chrome DevTools MCP with the chrome-profile CLI, deterministic profile discovery and URL-anchor tab selection. - Invoke when automation needs the user's own cookies or account.
- ak-code-review: Review code for bugs, regressions, maintainability, reliability and verification gaps with evidence. - Invoke for pending changes, a PR number, a commit hash or a codebase scan.
- ak-codex-goal: Guide long-running Codex /goal work to a verifiable stop condition, not generic iteration loops or multi-CLI orchestration. - Use for goal mode, durable objectives or autonomous multi-turn runs.

<system-reminder>
The following skills are available for use with the Skill tool:

- mdview: View a markdown or docs file in the local mdview browser viewer and return a shareable URL. Use when the user asks to preview/open/render a markdown file, or after writing docs that read better in a browser (long docs, tables, Mermaid diagrams, multi-file doc sets).

- ak-agentkit: Route AgentKit work by classifying the task, chaining installed skills and spawning subagents at trigger points; also operate the ak CLI. - Invoke at the start of multi-step work, when the right skill is unclear, or when the next action is an ak subcommand.
- ak-ai-artist: Generate mockups, brand visuals and concept art via Nano Banana in search, creative or wild mode, with styles like Ukiyo-e and Bento grid. - Invoke for visual assets or prompt search.

- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts. - Load before writing any artifact, including a skill-instructed Markdown one - Markdown is never a shortcut past the design pass.
- artifact-diagramming: Diagramming know-how for Artifacts - when a picture earns its place, how to draw one that shows the real mechanism, and the inline-SVG mechanics that keep it legible in both themes.
- artifact-capabilities: Runtime capabilities a published Artifact page can be granted — behavior static HTML cannot provide on its own, such as the page reading live or connected data, remembering what people do on it (a poll, a sign-up sheet, a checklist, a document edited in place — it saves new versions of itself), keeping state shared across viewers, knowing who is viewing, asking Claude a question of its own, storing files people add, handing the viewer a file to save, or using the viewer's camera, microphone, location, screen or device motion. Serves this user's live capability roster and the typed call definitions. Load it whenever any such runtime behavior would make an artifact more useful, before writing the page.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's recipe covers them) at the effort level given first, before any target (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings to many, some uncertain); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply them to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default. - Use the max level only when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask for it, never on your own judgment: it is the costliest level and starts many reviewer subagents.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- workflow-authoring: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script (script API and gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples). Load before authoring a script for a workflow the user already opted into; it does not itself authorize running one.
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

# Phase 1: Hạ tầng fork và theo upstream

## Overview

Dựng cỗ máy giữ fork luôn theo upstream: cài đặt fork, script catchup dựng nhánh phát hành từ mỗi tag upstream và áp chuỗi bản vá, CI chạy catchup và mở issue khi hỏng, gói dựng sẵn cho 4 nền. Phục vụ G1, G4. Mọi bản vá ở phase 2, 3 cần V01 để được áp và kiểm.

## Việc

| ID | Việc | Cần | Mức | Công | PRD |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V00 | Phần còn lại của cài đặt fork: `.gitignore` cho `vantt/` (`vantt/.catchup-state.json`, `vantt/reports/*.json` trừ bản phát hành, `vantt/.work/`), cách clone submodule trên CI, ghi trạng thái vào `vantt/README.md`. Bật Actions và tắt workflow upstream làm cùng V02 khi đã có workflow `vantt-*` | — | rẻ | 0,5 | 5 |
| V01 | `vantt/scripts/catchup.mjs` (Node ESM, không phụ thuộc), test vitest trên repo git tạm (PRD 11.2, T8 diễn tập xung đột), skill `.claude/skills/ohs-catchup/SKILL.md`, xuất lại bản vá sau khi sửa xung đột | V00 | mạnh | 2 | 4.1, 6, 11.2 |
| V02 | `.github/workflows/vantt-catchup.yml` (cron và chạy tay, chỉ trên `vantt/obsidian-hybrid-search`, mở issue khi hỏng, không trùng), `vantt-pr-check.yml` (chặn commit trên `master` chạm file upstream). Sau đó bật Actions, tắt `ci.yml`, `auto-tag.yml`, `release.yml`, `update-deps.yml` | V01 | vừa | 0,5 | 5, 7.1, 7.2, 7.4 |

- `vantt/packages/ohs-lang-vi/**`. Trong đó `src/query.ts` và `src/index.ts` dùng chung giữa V13, V17–V20: làm tuần tự.

- [ ] V09 M1 chuẩn hoá, bỏ dấu, âm tiết, bảng dữ liệu
- [ ] V13 M2, M3 view, phân tích câu, phục hồi dấu, chấm lại
- [ ] V17 Telex/VNI và gõ sai
- [ ] V18 đồng nghĩa, viết tắt, `learn-abbr`
- [ ] V19 alias không dấu, đoạn trích chữ gốc
- [ ] V20 tách từ

- V09: test của gói xanh; `project` trên 1 MB văn bản dưới 200 ms; `analyzeQuery` câu 12 âm tiết với từ vựng 50.000 term dưới 20 ms.
- V13: đạt mục tiêu G3 trên corpus sinh: `vi-unaccented`, `vi-dd` Hit@5 ≥ 0,85 và gấp tối thiểu 2 lần baseline upstream; `vi-accented` không tụt; `vi-tone-precision` MRR ≥ 0,9; eval upstream có gói không tụt quá 0,01 nDCG@5.
- V17: `vi-telex`, `vi-typo` Hit@5 ≥ 0,8; hạng mục khác không tụt.
- V18: `vi-synonym`, `vi-abbr` Hit@5 ≥ 0,8; đổi đồng nghĩa hay viết tắt không dựng lại index.
- V19: `vi-alias` Hit@5 ≥ 0,8; `vi-snippet` 100% đoạn trích là chữ gốc và chứa chỗ khớp.
- V20: `vi-compound` nDCG@5 hơn baseline upstream tối thiểu 0,1; chốt mặc định `segment`.

- Sửa Telex đổi nhầm chữ tiếng Anh: chỉ áp cho token không có trong từ vựng vault mà dạng giải ra có trong từ vựng.
- Không có từ điển đạt giấy phép: dựng từ thống kê cặp âm tiết trên corpus sinh và ghi rõ.

# Phase 5: Đo lường và cổng chất lượng

## Overview

Bộ eval tiếng Việt, bài kiểm bất biến, cổng chất lượng nối vào catchup, eval trên vault thật của user, và đợt eval nhánh nghĩa. Phục vụ G2, G3, G8, G10. V10 bắt đầu ngay vì phase 4 cần nó để chốt tham số.

## Việc

| ID | Việc | Cần | Mức | Công | PRD |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V10 | Preset `vi-search` trong obsidian-test-fixture (kèm file lexicon mẫu), golden set 17 hạng mục × 15 câu theo định dạng eval của upstream, smoke-vault, baseline upstream không gói ở `vantt/eval/baselines/<platform>/` | — | vừa | 2,5 | 11.3, 11.5 |
| V12 | `vantt/scripts/invariance.mjs` (không gói thì `top_paths` từng câu trùng 100% với upstream cùng tag, cùng máy, cùng lần chạy), `vantt/scripts/quality-gate.mjs`, nối cả hai vào catchup để chạy đủ T1–T5 | V10, V11 | vừa | 1 | 11.1, 11.4, 11.6 |
| V15 | Eval trên vault thật của user: golden set riêng khoảng 60 câu do user gán nhãn, lưu ngoài repo, chạy ở máy user bằng `quality-gate.mjs --private <path>`; chỉ ghi số tổng hợp vào `vantt/reviews/` | V13, user | vừa | 0,5 + user | 11.5 |
| V22 | Một đợt eval nhánh nghĩa: mỗi model nhúng (e5-small, e5-base, bge-m3, một model chuyên tiếng Việt chạy được bằng ONNX) × `restoreForEmbedding` bật/tắt × rerank có/không; mỗi model index một lần; đo nDCG@5, Hit@5, mức tách cặp gần nghĩa thật với cặp nhiễu, thời gian index, thời gian mỗi câu, RAM, dung lượng | V13 | vừa | 2–2,5 | 2.1 (G10), 15 (Q3) |

Song song: V10 ngay từ đầu. V12 khi V10 và V11 xong. V15 và V22 sau V13, chạy song song với V17–V20.

## Quy tắc riêng

- Eval upstream ghi DB vào thư mục vault và dựng lại toàn bộ: chạy trên bản sao, không trên vault thật của user trong CI.
- ONNX lượng tử cho số khác nhau theo CPU: baseline theo từng nền; bất biến so cùng máy, cùng lần chạy.
- Hạ baseline chỉ qua PR có người duyệt, kèm lý do.
- Không đưa nội dung vault thật hay câu hỏi của user vào repo, CI, log, báo cáo; chỉ số tổng hợp.
- V22 không đổi model mặc định của upstream trong lõi; kết quả là đề xuất cho bộ cài dự án và chốt Q3.

## File sở hữu

- V10: `vantt/eval/vi/**`, `vantt/eval/baselines/**`; preset `vi-search` trong repo `vantt/obsidian-test-fixture` (của user, nhánh `main`, công khai). User cho phép agent đẩy (2026-11-02); làm trên nhánh riêng rồi merge vào `main`, chỉ chứa dữ liệu sinh.
- V12: `vantt/scripts/invariance.mjs`, `vantt/scripts/quality-gate.mjs`; móc vào `vantt/scripts/catchup.mjs` qua lead.
- V15: `vantt/reviews/vault-eval-<date>.md`.
- V22: `vantt/reviews/semantic-eval-<date>.md`, script đo ở `vantt/scripts/`.

## Todo

- [ ] V10 bộ eval tiếng Việt và baseline upstream
- [ ] V12 bất biến và cổng chất lượng nối vào catchup
- [ ] V15 eval trên vault thật (chờ user gán nhãn)
- [ ] V22 đợt eval model nhúng, `restoreForEmbedding`, reranker

## Success Criteria

- V10: golden set đủ 17 hạng mục × 15 câu; `npm run eval` chạy được trên corpus sinh; baseline ghi trong `vantt/eval/baselines/`.
- V12: `catchup.mjs --with-lang vi` chạy đủ T1–T5; bất biến trùng 100% khi không gói.
- V15: số tổng hợp trong `vantt/reviews/`, không có nội dung vault.
- V22: báo cáo trong `vantt/reviews/` kèm đề xuất model, `restoreForEmbedding`, bật hay tắt reranker cho bộ cài dự án.

## Risk

- `vantt/obsidian-test-fixture` là repo công khai: preset chỉ chứa văn bản sinh, không chép nội dung vault thật hay câu hỏi riêng của user.
- Model lớn quá chậm trên máy CPU thường: đo và ghi; không chọn model làm index vault 2.000 note quá 30 phút mà không báo user.

<result>Status: DONE_WITH_CONCERNS

Summary: I built `vantt/packages/ohs-lang-vi/` with `normalize.ts`, `fold.ts`, `syllable.ts`, `data.ts` and table, fast-check and perf tests. `npm test` passes (6 files, 334 tests) and `tsc --noEmit` is clean. The sub-plan is marked completed.

Files changed:
- `vantt/packages/ohs-lang-vi/`: `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.build.json`, `vitest.config.ts`, `.gitignore` (ignores `node_modules/` and the build output), `src/` (`data.ts`, `chars.ts`, `normalize.ts`, `fold.ts`, `syllable.ts`, `index.ts`) and `test/` (data, normalize, fold, syllable, properties, perf, plus helpers and a tone-pairs fixture).
- `vantt/plans/261102-0355-v09-vi-pack-m1/plan.md`: sub-plan with scope, done-criteria and results. I deleted the template `phase-01-start.md` that `ak plan create` generated.

Test/perf results:
- **Tests:** 20 fast-check properties pass at 400 runs each. They cover idempotence, NFC/NFD equality, the token invariant (same count, token k maps to token k), non-letters preserved, and ASCII/English text only changing case. Tone-placement tests use 110 classic/modern pairs and run on NFC and NFD input.
- **1 MB projection, against the 200 ms budget** (`project` itself is V13's `views.ts`, so these time the M1 pieces):
  - `normalize`: 48 ms on a cold cache, 42 ms on NFD input.
  - `fold`: 17 ms.
  - `fold(normalize(x))`: 55 ms.
  - Worst case (all distinct words, cold cache): 144 ms.
  - 10 KB: 0.6 ms.
- **12-syllable query** (normalize, fold, parse, unaccented-form lookup): 1.8 ms cold including the one-time table build, 0.004 ms warm. The 20 ms `analyzeQuery` check on a 50,000-term vocabulary belongs to V13.

Concerns/Blockers:
- I could not run `npm run build`: the project's scout-block hook rejects commands containing "build". `tsc --noEmit` passes, but `tsconfig.build.json` and the output folder (`build/` rather than the usual `dist/`, for the same reason) are untested.
- The 144 ms worst-case perf test uses cold caches, so it could be flaky on a slow CI machine. Typical cases are about 4x under budget.
- I made the following decisions that PRD 10.3 left open. All are recorded in the sub-plan:
  - `tonePlacement` defaults to `modern` (hoà, khoẻ, thuỷ).
  - `IY_ONSETS` is k l m t s h v d qu. I left out `ng` because `ngi` and `ngy` are not valid spellings.

# Phase 1: Hạ tầng fork và theo upstream

## Overview

Dựng cỗ máy giữ fork luôn theo upstream: cài đặt fork, script catchup dựng nhánh phát hành từ mỗi tag upstream và áp chuỗi bản vá, CI chạy catchup và mở issue khi hỏng, gói dựng sẵn cho 4 nền. Phục vụ G1, G4. Mọi bản vá ở phase 2, 3 cần V01 để được áp và kiểm.

## Việc

| ID | Việc | Cần | Mức | Công | PRD |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V00 | Phần còn lại của cài đặt fork: `.gitignore` cho `vantt/` (`vantt/.catchup-state.json`, `vantt/reports/*.json` trừ bản phát hành, `vantt/.work/`), cách clone submodule trên CI, ghi trạng thái vào `vantt/README.md`. Bật Actions và tắt workflow upstream làm cùng V02 khi đã có workflow `vantt-*` | — | rẻ | 0,5 | 5 |
| V01 | `vantt/scripts/catchup.mjs` (Node ESM, không phụ thuộc), test vitest trên repo git tạm (PRD 11.2, T8 diễn tập xung đột), skill `.claude/skills/ohs-catchup/SKILL.md`, xuất lại bản vá sau khi sửa xung đột | V00 | mạnh | 2 | 4.1, 6, 11.2 |
| V02 | `.github/workflows/vantt-catchup.yml` (cron và chạy tay, chỉ trên `vantt/obsidian-hybrid-search`, mở issue khi hỏng, không trùng), `vantt-pr-check.yml` (chặn commit trên `master` chạm file upstream). Sau đó bật Actions, tắt `ci.yml`, `auto-tag.yml`, `release.yml`, `update-deps.yml` | V01 | vừa | 0,5 | 5, 7.1, 7.2, 7.4 |
| V03 | `vantt/scripts/bundle.mjs` và `vantt-bundles.yml`: gói cho Windows x64, macOS ARM, macOS Intel, Linux x64, sha256, smoke test trên runner sạch (gồm cả `ohs serve --stdio`), ghi kích thước | V02 | vừa | 2 | 7.3, 8 |

## Quy tắc riêng

- Catchup chỉ chọn tag nằm trên `upstream/master` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`) và không bao giờ `git push --tags`; chỉ đẩy tag `vX.Y.Z-vantt.N` (PRD 5).
- Remote `upstream` đã thêm, chỉ theo `master`, đẩy bị chặn. Không fetch nhánh khác của upstream.
- Bật Actions và tạo release đầu tiên là việc ra ngoài: lead xin user xác nhận trước.

## File sở hữu

- V00: `vantt/.gitignore`, `vantt/README.md`.
- V01: `vantt/scripts/catchup.mjs`, `vantt/scripts/lib/*`, `vantt/scripts/test/catchup*.test.*`, `.claude/skills/ohs-catchup/`.
- V02: `.github/workflows/vantt-catchup.yml`, `.github/workflows/vantt-pr-check.yml`.
- V03: `vantt/scripts/bundle.mjs`, `.github/workflows/vantt-bundles.yml`.

## Todo

- [x] V00 cài đặt fork xong
- [ ] V01 catchup và skill `ohs-catchup`
- [ ] V02 CI catchup và pr-check, Actions chỉ còn `vantt-*`
- [ ] V03 gói dựng sẵn 4 nền và smoke

## Success Criteria

- V00: `gh workflow list --repo vantt/obsidian-hybrid-search --all` chỉ có `vantt-*` ở trạng thái active (kiểm sau V02).
- V01: chạy trên `v0.17.2` ra nhánh `vantt/v0.17.2` xanh với chuỗi bản vá rỗng và với bản vá giả; diễn tập xung đột trả mã 3, `--abort` trả repo sạch, `--continue` sau khi sửa thì xanh và bản vá được xuất lại.
- V02: chạy tay xanh; một lần hỏng cố ý mở đúng một issue.
- V03: Release có 4 gói kèm sha256; smoke xanh cả 4 nền; kích thước được ghi.

## Risk

- Checkout tag làm mất `vantt/`: sao ra `vantt/.work/` rồi chép lại (bài học herdr, PRD 4.1).
- Đẩy nhánh có workflow bị GitHub chặn: gỡ workflow upstream khỏi nhánh phát hành, cần PAT `VANTT_PUSH_TOKEN` nếu vẫn bị chặn (PRD 5 bước 7).
- Gatekeeper, SmartScreen chặn trong smoke: báo user (Q4), không tự mua chứng chỉ.

- **Fake pack `lang-upper`:**
  - View tables are created and the view branch shows up in RRF and in `explain`.
  - Title mode also searches the view's title column.
  - Snippets come back as original text, including joined `_` tokens ("grosse strasse" gives `["Große", "Straße"]`).
  - A pack that breaks the token invariant falls back to the note start and logs a warning.
  - `aliasViews` matches projected aliases.
  - `rescore` never adds or drops candidates and ignores unknown paths and NaN scores.
  - `queryCacheKey` invalidates the search cache without reindexing.
  - Changing the pack signature, or removing the pack, rebuilds only the views: zero embedder calls and `vec_chunks` unchanged.

- **Separate signature:** the pack's identity is stored in `settings.language_pack`, not appended to `content_policy`. This deviates from the PRD wording, which the PRD itself allows. On a mismatch, only the views are rebuilt from the `notes` table in one transaction: no vault scan and no embedding. Without a pack, `content_policy` stays exactly as upstream.
- **Clearer token invariant:** the PRD says original text is tokenized with plain `unicode61 remove_diacritics 0`. That breaks with the default view tokenizer: `"a+b"` would be 1 token in the view and 2 in the original. I tokenize the original with the view's own `tokenchars` minus `_` instead, and the spec documents this.

- `QueryContext.dbVersion()`: the vi `restore` module caches its vocabulary per `db_version` (PRD 10.3), which the contract did not expose.

- **Fake pack `lang-upper`:**
  - View tables are created and the view branch shows up in RRF and in `explain`.
  - Title mode also searches the view's title column.
  - Snippets come back as original text, including joined `_` tokens ("grosse strasse" gives `["Große", "Straße"]`).
  - A pack that breaks the token invariant falls back to the note start and logs a warning.
  - `aliasViews` matches projected aliases.
  - `rescore` never adds or drops candidates and ignores unknown paths and NaN scores.
  - `queryCacheKey` invalidates the search cache without reindexing.
  - Changing the pack signature, or removing the pack, rebuilds only the views: zero embedder calls and `vec_chunks` unchanged.

You are a sub-agent doing a follow-up to task V10 (Vietnamese eval set) for the fork at /home/vantt/projects/obsidian-hybrid-search (shared tree on master; other agents work there concurrently). Timezone Asia/Saigon, today 2026-11-02. Docs in Vietnamese, code in English.

## Context
V10 is done: preset `vi-search` in public repo `vantt/obsidian-test-fixture` (main, tag v0.9.0, commit 30efc05), golden set `vantt/eval/vi/golden-set.json` (17 categories × 15), runner `vantt/eval/vi/run-eval.mjs`, baseline `vantt/eval/baselines/linux-x64/0.17.2.vi-search.json`, docs `vantt/eval/vi/README.md`, sub-plan `vantt/plans/261102-0404-v10-vi-eval-set/plan.md`. Problem: upstream WITHOUT any pack already gets Hit@5 0.93 on `vi-unaccented` and 0.87 on `vi-dd`, so goal G3 ("Hit@5 ≥ 0.85 AND at least 2× upstream baseline", PRD 11.6) is impossible. The user decided (2026-11-02): make the corpus harder, keep the PRD thresholds. The corpus does not reproduce the real failure described in PRD 3.5 (FTS5 cannot match unaccented queries; semantic branch probably rescues them because queries are too distinctive / titles leak). 

## Task A — harder corpus
Diagnose why upstream already finds unaccented/dd queries (inspect per-query results; check whether vector branch or title matching rescues them; check distractors). Then change the preset so these categories reflect the real-world difficulty: e.g. many near-duplicate notes on the same topic differing in the accented key term, distractor notes sharing semantic content, queries whose only discriminating signal is the unaccented lexical term, no title leaks. Keep it realistic and synthetic only (public repo). Keep the generator's self-check. Target: upstream baseline Hit@5 for `vi-unaccented` and `vi-dd` ≤ ~0.42 so 2× is achievable with a perfect lexical fold, while still ≥0.85 being achievable by an accent-folding pack (sanity check: a query with accents restored should find its note). Do not make other categories trivially impossible; re-check every category's baseline. Work in the fixture repo on a branch, merge to main, tag a new version, push (the user authorized pushing to that repo). Use HUSKY=0 for commits there.
Re-run baseline and update `vantt/eval/vi/golden-set.json`, smoke files if affected, `vantt/eval/baselines/linux-x64/*`, and README per-category table.

Add to `vantt/eval/vi/run-eval.mjs` options to evaluate an OHS build other than the shared tree (e.g. `--ohs <dir>` pointing to a worktree/build of the release branch) and to enable a language pack (`--lang-pack <path-or-module>` plus `--lang-options <json>` if useful), using exactly the configuration mechanism defined by patch P01 — read `vantt/patches/0001-language-pack-api.spec.md` and the patch for env vars/config names. A built P01 tree exists at worktree /tmp/claude-1000/-home-vantt-projects-obsidian-hybrid-search/c4caee3c-648b-4dec-9db9-7046ba7beb6d/scratchpad/wt-v11 (branch vantt/work/p01-language-pack-api) — you can use it read-only for testing, or make your own worktree. Agents V12 (quality gate) and V13 (vi pack tuning) will use these options; document them in README. Also output JSON suitable for comparing two runs.

npm note: upstream pins npm 12.2.0 via devEngines; machine npm 11.19 refuses — use `npx -y npm@12.2.0 ...`.

## Constraints
- In the shared tree modify ONLY `vantt/eval/**` and append a "Bổ sung" section to `vantt/plans/261102-0404-v10-vi-eval-set/plan.md`. Don't commit/push/checkout in the shared tree (lead commits). Never touch upstream files.
- Only synthetic text in the fixture repo.
- If stuck after two attempts, spawn `kongming`.

End with:
Status: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT
Summary; Files changed; fixture commit + tag; new baseline per category (brief); runner options; Concerns.
